requirements.title: 1. Atomic variable
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall define an atomic variable type whose size matches the native word size of the target architecture: 32 bits on 32-bit architectures and 64 bits on 64-bit architectures.

requirements.title: 2. Atomic value
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall define a signed integer type, whose size is determined by the target processor architecture, used as the parameter and return type of operations on atomic variables.

requirements.title: 3. Tearing freedom
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall guarantee that each operation on an atomic variable is free from torn reads or writes.

requirements.title: 4. Cross-CPU visibility
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall guarantee that the result of each operation on an atomic variable is visible to all processors in the system.

requirements.title: 5. Indivisibility
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for performing all operations on an atomic variable in an indivisible manner.

requirements.title: 6. Memory ordering
requirements.requirement_text: When performing an operation on an atomic variable, the Zephyr RTOS shall provide full memory barrier semantics, such that memory operations issued before the atomic operation are observed before it and memory operations issued after it are observed after it.

requirements.title: 7. Software implementation fallback
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support executing atomic operations on hardware that does not provide native atomic instruction support.

requirements.title: 8. Native atomic instructions
requirements.requirement_text: Where the target hardware provides native atomic instructions, the Zephyr RTOS shall support implementing atomic operations using those instructions.

requirements.title: 9. Compute size of atomic variables
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a compile-time mechanism for computing the minimum number of atomic variables necessary to represent a bit array of a given number of bits.

requirements.title: 10. Define an array of atomic variables

requirements.title: 11. Initialize atomic variable

requirements.title: 12. Set atomic variable

requirements.title: 13. Get atomic variable

requirements.title: 14. Atomic bitwise operations

requirements.title: 1. Dynamic initialization of condition variables
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a condition variable dynamically (at runtime).

requirements.title: 2. Static initialization of condition variables
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a condition variable statically (at compile time).

requirements.title: 3. Signal one waiting thread
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to signal the highest priority waiting thread when a condition is met.

requirements.title: 4. Signal multiple waiting threads

requirements.title: 5. Wait on a condition variable
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to wait on a condition variable.

requirements.requirement_text: When waiting on a condition variable, the thread shall specify a timeout value.

requirements.title: 7. Wait timeout occurence
requirements.requirement_text: When a timeout occurs while waiting on a condition variable, the thread shall be unblocked and a timeout error shall be returned.

requirements.title: 8. Release mutex on wait

requirements.title: 9. Unblock a waiting thread
requirements.requirement_text: Whenever a thread signals a condition variable, the Zephyr RTOS shall unblock the highest priority thread currently waiting on that condition variable.

requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an event object capable of tracking up to 32 distinct events.

requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to post one or more events to an event object, merging them with the events currently tracked by the event object.

requirements.title: 2.2. Setting events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to set the events tracked by an event object to a specified value, replacing the events currently tracked by the event object.

requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to clear specified events tracked by an event object.

requirements.title: 2.5. Reporting the previous events
requirements.requirement_text: When the events tracked by an event object are modified, the Zephyr RTOS shall report the value that the modified events had before the operation.

requirements.requirement_text: When a modification of the events tracked by an event object satisfies the waiting condition of a thread waiting on that event object, the Zephyr RTOS shall unpend that thread.

requirements.title: 3.1. Waiting for any of a set of events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to wait until any of a specified set of events is tracked by an event object.

requirements.title: 3.2. Waiting for all of a set of events

requirements.title: 3.3. Event wait timeout

requirements.title: 3.4. Event wait timeout expiry

requirements.title: 3.5. Reporting matching events on wait completion
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread waiting on an event object completes its wait successfully, the Zephyr RTOS shall report the set of events that matched the waiting condition.

requirements.title: 3.6. Resetting events before waiting
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread waits on an event object, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept an option to clear the events tracked by the event object before the wait begins.

requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide abstraction of device drivers with common functionalities as an intermediate interface between applications and device drivers, where such interface is implemented by individual device drivers. Proposal for replacement: Zephyr shall provide an interface between application and individual device drivers to provide an abstraction of device drivers with common functionalities.

requirements.title: 4.2. Expose kernel to hardware interrupts
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface for managing a defined set of hardware exceptions (including interrupts) across all systems.

requirements.title: 5.1.1. Event object definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize an event object at compile time.

requirements.title: 5.1.2. Event object definition at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize an event object at run time.

requirements.title: 5.1.3. Number of distinct events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an event object capable of tracking up to 32 distinct events.

requirements.title: 5.2.1. Posting events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to post one or more events to an event object, merging them with the events currently tracked by the event object.

requirements.title: 5.2.2. Setting events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to set the events tracked by an event object to a specified value, replacing the events currently tracked by the event object.

requirements.title: 5.2.3. Setting and clearing events using a mask
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to set the events selected by a mask to specified values, leaving the events tracked by the event object that are not selected by the mask unchanged.

requirements.title: 5.2.4. Clearing events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to clear specified events tracked by an event object.

requirements.title: 5.2.5. Reporting the previous events
requirements.requirement_text: When the events tracked by an event object are modified, the Zephyr RTOS shall report the value that the modified events had before the operation.

requirements.title: 5.2.6. Unpending threads whose conditions are met
requirements.requirement_text: When a modification of the events tracked by an event object satisfies the waiting condition of a thread waiting on that event object, the Zephyr RTOS shall unpend that thread.

requirements.title: 5.3.1. Waiting for any of a set of events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to wait until any of a specified set of events is tracked by an event object.

requirements.title: 5.3.2. Waiting for all of a set of events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to wait until all of a specified set of events are tracked by an event object.

requirements.title: 5.3.3. Event wait timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread waits on an event object, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for the desired set of events.

requirements.title: 5.3.4. Event wait timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When the timeout of a thread waiting on an event object elapses before the desired set of events is satisfied, the Zephyr RTOS shall report that no matching events were delivered.

requirements.title: 5.3.5. Reporting matching events on wait completion
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread waiting on an event object completes its wait successfully, the Zephyr RTOS shall report the set of events that matched the waiting condition.

requirements.title: 5.3.6. Resetting events before waiting
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread waits on an event object, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept an option to clear the events tracked by the event object before the wait begins.

requirements.title: 6.1. Fatal Exception Error Handler
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide default handlers for exceptions.

requirements.title: 6.2. Default handler for fatal errors
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide default handlers for fatal errors that do not have a dedicated handler.

requirements.title: 6.3. Assigning a specific handler
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to assign a specific handler for an exception.

requirements.title: 6.4. Assigning a specific handler for a fatal error
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to assign a specific handler for a fatal error.

requirements.title: 7.1. FIFO definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a FIFO at compile time.

requirements.title: 7.2. FIFO cancel waiting thread
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for the first thread waiting to get and dequeue a data item to return as if the timeout had expired.

requirements.title: 7.3. FIFO enqueue item to the back
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to enqueue a data item to the back of a FIFO (i.e. append).

requirements.title: 1. Installing static IRQ service routines (ISR).
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a static IRQ service routine (ISR), providing all parameters needed to configure the hardware and software.

requirements.title: 2. Static IRQ initial status.
requirements.requirement_text: The static IRQ shall be initially disabled.

requirements.title: 3. Installing direct IRQ service routines (ISR).
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a direct IRQ handler, providing all parameters needed to configure the hardware and software.

requirements.title: 4. Direct IRQ initial status.
requirements.requirement_text: The direct IRQ shall be initially disabled.

requirements.title: 5. Installing dynamic IRQ service routines (ISR).
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a dynamic IRQ service routine, providing all parameters needed to configure the hardware and software.

requirements.title: 6. Dynamic IRQ initial status.
requirements.requirement_text: The dynamic IRQ shall be initially disabled.

requirements.title: 7. Uninstalling dynamic IRQ service routines (ISR).
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to uninstall a dynamic ISR.

requirements.title: 8. Global IRQ disable
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to disable all IRQs on a CPU and return the state of the IRQ hardware prior to being disabled.

requirements.title: 9. Global IRQ enable
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to enable all IRQs on a CPU and return them to their previous state.

requirements.title: 10. Specific IRQ disable
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to disable a specified IRQ.

requirements.title: 11. Specific IRQ enable
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to enable a specified IRQ.

requirements.title: 12. IRQ Enabled status
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism that returns the enabled status of a specified IRQ, where the status is enabled or disabled.

requirements.title: 13. ISR Context status
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism that returns the execution context, where the context is In-ISR or Not In-ISR.

requirements.title: 14. Multi-level interrupts
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support multi-level preemptive interrupt priorities, when supported by hardware.

requirements.title: 15. Interrupt service routine invocation
requirements.requirement_text: When an enabled IRQ that has a connected interrupt service routine is asserted, the Zephyr RTOS shall invoke the associated interrupt service routine.

requirements.title: 16. Interrupt service routine parameter
requirements.requirement_text: When the Zephyr RTOS invokes a static or dynamic interrupt service routine, it shall pass to the routine the parameter that was registered with it.

requirements.title: 1.1. System uptime in milliseconds
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to obtain the time elapsed since the system booted, expressed in milliseconds.

requirements.title: 1.2. System uptime in system ticks
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to obtain the time elapsed since the system booted, expressed in system ticks.

requirements.title: 1.3. System uptime in seconds
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to obtain the time elapsed since the system booted, expressed in seconds.

requirements.title: 1.4. Elapsed time relative to a reference
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to obtain the time elapsed, in milliseconds, since a caller-provided reference time, and to replace that reference time with the current system uptime.

requirements.title: 2.1. Hardware clock cycle count
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to read the current value of the system's hardware clock as a 32-bit cycle count.

requirements.title: 2.2. 64-bit hardware clock cycle count
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to read the current value of the system's hardware clock as a 64-bit cycle count.

requirements.title: 3.1. Conversion between time units
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to convert time values between milliseconds, microseconds, nanoseconds, system ticks, and hardware cycles.

requirements.title: 4.1. Suspending a thread for a duration
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to suspend the execution of the calling thread for a specified duration, where the duration may be expressed in milliseconds, microseconds, nanoseconds, system ticks, or hardware cycles.

requirements.title: 4.2. Suspending a thread with microsecond resolution
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to suspend the execution of the calling thread for a duration specified in microseconds.

requirements.title: 4.3. Thread readiness after sleep
requirements.requirement_text: When the duration for which a thread was suspended elapses, the Zephyr RTOS shall make the thread eligible for execution again.

requirements.title: 4.4. Waking a sleeping thread
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to prematurely wake a thread that is suspended for a duration.

requirements.title: 4.5. Reporting remaining time on premature wake
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread suspended for a specified duration is woken before that duration has elapsed, the Zephyr RTOS shall report the amount of time that was remaining, expressed in milliseconds.

requirements.title: 4.6. Reporting remaining time on premature wake with microsecond resolution
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread suspended for a duration specified in microseconds is woken before that duration has elapsed, the Zephyr RTOS shall report the amount of time that was remaining, expressed in microseconds.

requirements.title: 4.7. Busy waiting
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for the calling thread to busy wait for a specified number of microseconds without relinquishing the CPU.

requirements.title: 5.1. Absolute timeouts
requirements.requirement_text: Where 64-bit timeouts are enabled, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept timeouts specified as an absolute point in time, in addition to timeouts specified as a relative duration.

requirements.title: 1. LIFO definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a LIFO at compile time.

requirements.title: 2. LIFO enqueue item to the back
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to enqueue a data item to the back of a LIFO (i.e. prepend).

requirements.title: 3. LIFO implicit memory allocation
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to allocate memory from a thread when enqueuing data items to a LIFO.

requirements.title: 4. LIFO get and dequeue item from front
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to get and dequeue a data item from the back of a LIFO, within a timeout.

requirements.title: 1. Dedicated Logging Thread Support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support isolation of logging from other functionality.

requirements.title: 2. Logs available for post processing
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS logging shall produce logs that are capable of being post processed.

requirements.title: 3. Formatting log messages
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS logging shall support formatting of log messages to enable filtering.

requirements.title: 4. Logging Filtering Support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS logging system shall support filtering based on severity level.

requirements.title: 5. Multiple Backend Logging Support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support logging messages to multiple system resources.

requirements.title: 6. Deferred Logging Support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support deferred logging.

requirements.title: 1. Mailbox Initialization At Run Time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a mailbox at run time.

requirements.title: 2. Mailbox Initialization At Compile Time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to statically define and initialize a mailbox object at compile time.

requirements.title: 3. Message Size Support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support messages containing zero or more bytes of data.

requirements.title: 4. Mailbox Data Transfer
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall handle the data transfer between mailbox objects of the sending and receiving threads.

requirements.title: 5. Synchronous Message Sending
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to send a message through a mailbox and block until the message is processed or a timeout occurs.

requirements.title: 6. Synchronous Send Timeout Handling
requirements.requirement_text: If the synchronous message send operation times out before a receiver processes the message, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an timeout error code to the sending thread.

requirements.title: 7. Asynchronous Message Sending
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to send a message through a mailbox without waiting for it to be processed.

requirements.title: 8. Asynchronous Completion Signaling
requirements.requirement_text: When a sending thread asynchronously sends a message to a mailbox object, the Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to signal to the sending thread that the message has been both received and completely processed by the receiver.

requirements.title: 9. Message Reception
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to receive a message via a mailbox object with a timeout parameter.

requirements.title: 10. Message Data Retrieval
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to retrieve message data via a mailbox object.

requirements.title: 11. Message Reception Blocking
requirements.requirement_text: When a receiving thread requests a message via a mailbox object and no message is available, the Zephyr RTOS shall block the receiving thread until a message is available or the timeout expires.

requirements.title: 12. Message Reception Timeout Handling
requirements.requirement_text: If the message receive operation times out before a message becomes available, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an appropriate timeout error code to the receiving thread.

requirements.title: 13. Non-Anonymous Messaging
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall handle message exchange via a mailbox object non-anonymously, allowing both the sending and receiving threads to know the identity of the other thread.

requirements.title: 14. Priority-Based Message Delivery
requirements.requirement_text: When multiple threads are waiting on an empty mailbox object, the Zephyr RTOS shall deliver the next message to the highest priority thread.

requirements.title: 15. Priority-Based Message Delivery
requirements.requirement_text: When multiple threads of equal priority are waiting on an empty mailbox object, the Zephyr RTOS shall deliver the next message to the thread that has waited the longest.

requirements.title: 16. Mailbox Quantity Support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support an arbitrary number of mailbox objects, limited only by available RAM in the system.

requirements.title: 17. Invalid Parameter Handling
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall handle invalid parameters by returning error codes rather than causing system failures.

requirements.title: 1. Dynamic Memory Allocation
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall allow threads to dynamically allocate variable-sized memory regions from a specified range of memory.

requirements.title: 2. Memory Slab Object
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall allow threads to dynamically allocate fixed-sized memory regions from a specified range of memory.

requirements.title: 3. Heap definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a memory heap at compile time.

requirements.title: 4. Heap initialization at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a memory heap at run time over a caller-provided memory region.

requirements.title: 5. Heap allocation
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to allocate a block of memory of a requested size from a heap.

requirements.title: 6. Heap aligned allocation
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to allocate a block of memory from a heap with a requested alignment.

requirements.title: 7. Heap allocation timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When allocating memory from a heap, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for sufficient memory to become available.

requirements.title: 8. Heap allocation failure
requirements.requirement_text: When sufficient memory cannot be allocated from a heap within the specified time, the Zephyr RTOS shall report that the allocation failed.

requirements.title: 9. Heap reallocation
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to resize a previously allocated heap block while preserving its contents up to the smaller of the old and new sizes.

requirements.title: 10. Heap free
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to release a previously allocated block of memory back to its heap.

requirements.title: 11. System heap allocation and release
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to allocate memory from and release memory to a shared system heap.

requirements.title: 12. Memory slab definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a memory slab of fixed-size blocks at compile time.

requirements.title: 13. Memory slab initialization at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a memory slab at run time over a caller-provided memory region.

requirements.title: 14. Memory slab block allocation
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to allocate a fixed-size block from a memory slab, accepting a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for a free block.

requirements.title: 15. Memory slab allocation timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When no block becomes available in a memory slab within the specified time, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that no block was allocated.

requirements.title: 16. Memory slab block free
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to release a previously allocated block back to its memory slab.

requirements.title: 17. Memory slab usage statistics
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to query the number of used and free blocks in a memory slab.

requirements.title: 18. Enumerating defined heaps
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to obtain the set of heaps that were defined at compile time.

requirements.title: 1. Memory Protection
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support memory protection features to isolate a thread's memory region.

requirements.title: 2. Granting access to kernel objects
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to grant user threads access to kernel objects.

requirements.title: 3. Separation between user and kernel threads for memory access
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall be able to differentiate between user threads and kernel threads for memory access.

requirements.title: 4. Safely handle unimplemented calls or invalid system calls
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall have a defined behaviour when an invocation of an unimplemented system call is made.

requirements.title: 5. Response to invalid system call IDs
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall have a defined behaviour when an invalid system call ID is used.

requirements.title: 6. Prevent user threads creating higher priority threads
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall prevent user threads from creating new threads that are higher priority than the caller.

requirements.title: 7. Revoking threads permissions on a kernel object
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support revoking permission to a kernel object. User mode threads may only revoke their own access to an object.

requirements.title: 8. Prevent user threads creating supervisor threads
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall prevent user threads from creating kernel threads.

requirements.title: 9. Reduced Privilege Level Threads
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall allow the creation of threads that run in reduced privilege level.

requirements.title: 10. User Mode Threads Performing Privileged Operations
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide system calls to allow user mode threads to perform privileged operations.

requirements.title: 11. User mode handling of detected stack overflow
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support a defined mechanism for user mode handling a of detected stack overflow.

requirements.title: 12. Stack Overflow Detection
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support detection of stack overflows.

requirements.title: 13. Boot Time Memory Access Policy
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support configurable access to memory during boot time.

requirements.title: 14. System Call Handler Functions
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide helper functions for system call handler functions to validate the inputs passed in from user mode before invoking the implementation function to protect the kernel.

requirements.title: 15. System Call C strings in user mode
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support system calls to be able to safely accept C strings passed in from user mode.

requirements.title: 16. Tracking kernel objects in used by user mode threads
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall track kernel objects that are used by user mode threads. Note: this means Zephyr shall track the resources used by the user mode thread (associate this with a user story).

requirements.title: 17. Granting threads access to specific memory
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall have an interface to request access to specific memory after initial allocation.

requirements.title: 18. Assigning memory pools to act as a thread resource pool
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support assigning a memory pool to act as that thread's resource pool.

requirements.title: 1.1. Message queue definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a message queue at compile time, for a specified message size, maximum number of messages, and buffer alignment.

requirements.title: 1.2. Message queue initialization at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a message queue at run time using a caller-provided buffer, a message size, and a maximum number of messages.

requirements.title: 1.3. Message queue initialization at run time with a dynamically allocated buffer
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a message queue at run time, allocating the message buffer on behalf of the caller for a requested message size and maximum number of messages.

requirements.title: 2.1. Sending a message to the back
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for threads and interrupt service routines to send a message to the back of a message queue.

requirements.title: 2.2. Sending a message to the front
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for threads and interrupt service routines to send a message to the front of a message queue.

requirements.title: 2.3. Send timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When sending a message to a message queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for space to become available.

requirements.title: 2.4. Send timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When sending a message to a message queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that the message was not sent when either of the following conditions is satisfied: the caller is a thread and space does not become available in the message queue within the specified maximum time the caller is an interrupt service routine and no space is available in the message queue

requirements.title: 3.1. Receiving a message
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for threads and interrupt service routines to receive and remove the message at the front of a message queue.

requirements.title: 3.2. Message retrieval order
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall return messages from a message queue to receivers in front-to-back order: messages sent to the back are received in the order in which they were sent, and a message sent to the front is received before the messages already in the queue.

requirements.title: 3.3. Receive timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When receiving a message from a message queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for a message to become available.

requirements.title: 3.4. Receive timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When receiving a message from a message queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that no message was received when either of the following conditions is satisfied: the caller is a thread and no message becomes available in the message queue within the specified maximum time the caller is an interrupt service routine and no message is available in the message queue

requirements.title: 4.1. Peeking at a message
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for threads and interrupt service routines to read the message at the front of a message queue without removing it.

requirements.title: 4.2. Peeking at a message by index
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for threads and interrupt service routines to read a message at a specified index of a message queue without removing it.

requirements.title: 4.3. Purging a message queue
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to discard all messages currently in a message queue.

requirements.title: 4.4. Purging with blocked senders
requirements.requirement_text: When a message queue is purged, the Zephyr RTOS shall unblock any threads waiting to send a message to that queue and return an error to them indicating that the message was not sent.

requirements.title: 4.5. Querying used message count
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to query the number of messages currently in a message queue.

requirements.title: 4.6. Querying free message count
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to query the number of free message slots in a message queue.

requirements.title: 4.7. Querying message queue attributes
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to query the attributes of a message queue, including its message size, its maximum number of messages, and the number of messages currently stored.

requirements.title: 4.8. Releasing a dynamically allocated message queue buffer
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to release the buffer of a message queue that was dynamically allocated.

requirements.title: 4.9. Releasing a buffer with waiting threads
requirements.requirement_text: When releasing the buffer of a message queue, if threads are waiting on the message queue, then the Zephyr RTOS shall not release the buffer and shall return an error indicating that the message queue is in use.

requirements.title: 1. Mutex Kernel Object
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mutex that allows threads to obtain mutually exclusive access to a shared resource.

requirements.title: 2. Mutex definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a mutex at compile time.

requirements.title: 3. Mutex definition at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a mutex at run time.

requirements.title: 4. Locking a mutex
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to lock a mutex and become its owner.

requirements.title: 5. Locking an unowned mutex
requirements.requirement_text: While a mutex is not owned by any thread, a thread that locks it shall acquire ownership of the mutex.

requirements.title: 6. Locking a mutex owned by another thread
requirements.requirement_text: While a mutex is owned by another thread, a thread that attempts to lock it shall be blocked until the mutex becomes available or the specified timeout elapses.

requirements.title: 7. Mutex lock timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When locking a mutex, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for the mutex to become available.

requirements.title: 8. Mutex lock timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When a mutex does not become available within the specified time, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that the mutex was not locked.

requirements.title: 9. Recursive mutex locking
requirements.requirement_text: While a thread owns a mutex, the Zephyr RTOS shall allow that thread to lock the same mutex again, and shall require the thread to unlock it the same number of times before it is released.

requirements.title: 10. Unlocking a mutex
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for the owning thread to unlock a mutex.

requirements.title: 11. Unlocking by a non-owner
requirements.requirement_text: If a thread that does not own a mutex attempts to unlock it, then the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error and shall not release the mutex.

requirements.title: 12. Priority inheritance
requirements.requirement_text: While a higher-priority thread is blocked waiting on a mutex, the Zephyr RTOS shall raise the priority of the owning thread to that of the highest-priority waiting thread until the mutex is released.

requirements.title: 1. Pipe definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a pipe at compile time.

requirements.title: 2. Pipe initialization at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a pipe at run time using a caller-provided buffer.

requirements.title: 3. Writing data to a pipe
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to write up to a requested number of bytes into a pipe.

requirements.title: 4. Reading data from a pipe
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to read up to a requested number of bytes from a pipe.

requirements.title: 5. Pipe write timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When writing to a pipe, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for space to become available.

requirements.title: 6. Pipe write timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When writing to a pipe, if no data can be written within the specified maximum time, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that no data was written.

requirements.title: 7. Pipe read timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When reading from a pipe, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for data to become available.

requirements.title: 8. Pipe read timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When reading from a pipe, if no data becomes available within the specified maximum time, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that no data was read.

requirements.title: 9. Resetting a pipe
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to reset a pipe, discarding any unread data and unblocking threads waiting on the pipe.

requirements.title: 10. Closing a pipe
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to close a pipe, unblocking threads waiting on the pipe.

requirements.title: 11. Operations on a closed pipe
requirements.requirement_text: When a read or write operation is attempted on a closed pipe, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that the pipe is closed.

requirements.title: 12. Operations interrupted by a reset
requirements.requirement_text: When a read or write operation is interrupted by a pipe reset, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that the operation was cancelled.

requirements.title: 1.1. Waiting for any of multiple poll events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to wait until any one of a specified set of poll events is ready.

requirements.title: 1.2. Supported poll event conditions
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support poll events that wait for the availability of a semaphore, a FIFO, a message queue, a pipe, and a poll signal.

requirements.title: 1.3. Poll event initialization
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide mechanisms to initialize a poll event at compile time or at run time, associating the event with a condition type, an operating mode, and the object to be monitored.

requirements.title: 1.4. Poll wait timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When a thread waits on a set of poll events, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept a timeout that specifies the maximum time to wait for an event to become ready.

requirements.title: 1.5. Reporting ready poll events
requirements.requirement_text: When a poll wait completes, the Zephyr RTOS shall report the state of each poll event so the caller can determine which events are ready.

requirements.title: 2.1. Poll signal object
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a poll signal object type that threads can wait on as a poll event.

requirements.title: 2.2. Poll signal initialization
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a poll signal object to the unsignaled state.

requirements.title: 2.3. Raising a poll signal
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to raise a poll signal with a caller-supplied result value.

requirements.title: 2.4. Persistence of a raised poll signal
requirements.requirement_text: While a poll signal is in the signaled state, the Zephyr RTOS shall report poll events waiting on that signal as ready, including waits that begin after the signal was raised.

requirements.title: 2.5. Resetting a poll signal
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to reset a poll signal to the unsignaled state.

requirements.title: 2.6. Querying a poll signal
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to fetch the signaled state and result value of a poll signal.

requirements.title: 1. Power State Control
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide control over changes to system power states.

requirements.title: 2. Power Management
requirements.requirement_text: TBD

requirements.title: 3. Notification of changes to system power states
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide notification of changes to system power states.

requirements.title: 1. Queue definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a queue at compile time.

requirements.title: 2. Queue definition at run time.
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a queue at run time.

requirements.title: 3. Queue enqueue item to the back
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to enqueue a data item to the back of a queue (i.e. append).

requirements.title: 4. Queue enqueue item to the front
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to enqueue a data item to the front of a queue (i.e. prepend).
ambiguities: Le texte contient peut-être plusieurs énoncés à vérifier.

requirements.title: 5. Queue remove item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to remove a specific data item from a queue.

requirements.title: 6. Queue get and dequeue item from front
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to get and dequeue a data item from the front of a queue, within a timeout.

requirements.title: 7. Queue empty check
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to check if a queue is empty.

requirements.title: 8. Queue peek item at back
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to peek at the data item at the back of a queue.

requirements.title: 9. Queue peek item at front
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to peek at the data item at the front of a queue.

requirements.title: 10. Queue insert
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to insert a data item behind another specific data item in a queue.

requirements.title: 11. Queue append item list to the back
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to append a list of data items to the back of a queue.

requirements.title: 12. Queue append and empty item list to the back
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to append a list of data items to the back of a queue and then empty the list.

requirements.title: 13. Queue append unique data item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to append a data item uniquely to the queue.

requirements.title: 14. Queue implicit memory allocation
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a dedicated mechanism to implicite allocate memory from a thread when appending data items to a queue.

requirements.title: 1. Counting Semaphore Definition At Compile Time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a semaphore at compile time.

requirements.title: 2. Counting Semaphore Definition At Run Time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a semaphore at runtime.

requirements.title: 3. Maximum limit of a semaphore
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall define the maximum limit of a semaphore when the semaphore is used for counting purposes and does not have an explicit limit.

requirements.title: 4. Initialialization with maximum count value
requirements.requirement_text: When initializing a counting semaphore, the maximum permitted count a semaphore can have shall be set.

requirements.title: 5. Initial semaphore value
requirements.requirement_text: When initializing a counting semaphore, the initial semaphore value shall be set.

requirements.title: 6. Semaphore acquisition mechanism
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism allowing threads to acquire a semaphore.

requirements.title: 7. Semaphore acquisition with count greater than zero
requirements.requirement_text: While the semaphore's count is greater than zero, the requesting thread shall acquire the semaphore and decrement its count.

requirements.title: 8. Semaphore acquisition with zero count
requirements.requirement_text: While the semaphore's count is zero, the requesting thread shall be blocked until the semaphore is released by another thread.

requirements.title: 9. Semaphore acquisition timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When attempting to acquire a semaphore, the Zephyr RTOS shall accept options that specify timeout periods, allowing threads to set a maximum wait time for semaphore acquisition.

requirements.title: 10. Semaphore acquisition timeout error handling
requirements.requirement_text: When attempting to acquire a semaphore, where the semaphore is not acquired within the specified time, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating a timeout.

requirements.title: 11. Semaphore acquisition no wait error handling
requirements.requirement_text: When attempting to acquire a semaphore, where the current count is zero and no timeout time was provided, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating the semaphore is busy.

requirements.title: 12. Semaphore release
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism allowing threads to release a semaphore.

requirements.title: 13. Semaphore count increment on release
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall increment the semaphore's count upon release.

requirements.title: 14. Highest-priority waiter unblocked on release
requirements.requirement_text: When there are threads waiting on the semaphore, the highest-priority waiting thread shall be unblocked and acquire the semaphore.

requirements.title: 15. Checking semaphore count
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for threads to check the current count of a semaphore without acquiring it.

requirements.title: 16. Semaphore reset
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism that resets the semaphore count to zero.

requirements.title: 17. Semaphore acquisitions abort after reset
requirements.requirement_text: When a semaphore is reset, the Zephyr RTOS shall abort all pending take operations on the semaphore, returning to the affected threads the same error used to indicate a wait timeout.

requirements.title: 18. Semaphore Initialization Option Validation
requirements.requirement_text: When initializing a counting semaphore, where the maximum permitted count of a semaphore is invalid, then the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating invalid values.

requirements.title: 19. Semaphore release at maximum count
requirements.requirement_text: When a semaphore is released while its count is already at the maximum permitted count, the Zephyr RTOS shall leave the count unchanged.

requirements.title: 20. Semaphore operations from interrupt context
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall allow a semaphore to be released from an interrupt service routine, and to be acquired from an interrupt service routine when no waiting is requested.

requirements.title: 1. Stack definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a stack at compile time.

requirements.title: 2. Stack initialization at run time with an user-defined memory area
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a stack at run time, using a data buffer provided by the user.

requirements.title: 3. Stack initialization at run time with automatically allocated memory area
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a stack at run time, with automatic allocation of the stack memory.

requirements.title: 4. Releasing a dynamically allocated stack buffer
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to deallocate all resources previously allocated by a run-time stack definition.

requirements.title: 5. Push an item to the stack
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to add a new item on top of the stack.

requirements.title: 6. Pop an item from the stack
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to retrieve the current item from the top of the stack and to remove such item from the stack.

requirements.title: 7. Pushing onto a full stack
requirements.requirement_text: If the stack is full when an item is pushed, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error and not add the item.

requirements.title: 8. Concurrent access protection
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to push items to or pop items from the same stack object from multiple execution contexts which can run concurrently.

requirements.title: 9. Stack data retrieval with timeout
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to allow waiting for a stack item availability within a specified timeout.

requirements.title: 10. Stack pop timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When no item becomes available on a stack within the specified time, the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating that no item was retrieved.

requirements.title: 1.1. Support operation on more than one CPU
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support operation on more than one physical CPU sharing the same kernel state.

requirements.title: 1.2. Running threads on specific CPUs
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface for running threads on specific sets of CPUs ( default is 1 CPU).

requirements.title: 1.3. Exclusion between physical CPUs
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface for mutual exclusion between multiple physical CPUs.

requirements.title: 2.1. Scheduling a thread based on an event
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to schedule a thread based on an event.

requirements.title: 2.2. Deadline Scheduling Priorities
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall organize running threads by earliest deadline first priority.

requirements.title: 2.3. Work Queue utility capable of running preemptible work items
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a thread-pooled work queue utility capable of running preemptible work items with specific scheduler priorities.

requirements.title: 2.4. Run user supplied functions in-order in a separate thread(s)
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface for running user-supplied functions.

requirements.title: 2.5. Organize running threads into a fixed list
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall organize running threads into a fixed list of numeric priorities.

requirements.title: 2.6. Preemption support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support preemption of a running thread by a higher priority thread.

requirements.title: 2.7. Un-preemptible thread priorities
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support thread priorities which cannot be preempted by other user threads.

requirements.title: 2.8. Time sharing of CPU resources
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support time sharing of CPU resources among threads of the same priority.

requirements.title: 1. Creating threads
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to create (start) a thread.

requirements.title: 2. Setting thread priority
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to set a thread's priority.

requirements.title: 3. Suspending a thread
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to suspend a thread.

requirements.title: 4. Resuming a suspended thread
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to resume a suspended thread.

requirements.title: 5. Resuming a suspended thread after a timeout
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to resume a suspended thread after a timeout.

requirements.title: 6. Deleting a thread
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to delete (end) a thread.

requirements.title: 7. Thread states
requirements.requirement_text: Threads shall have different states to fulfill the Life-cycle of a thread

requirements.title: 8. Thread stack objects
requirements.requirement_text: Every Thread shall have it's own stack.

requirements.title: 9. Thread privileges
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to create threads with defined privilege.

requirements.title: 10. Scheduling multiple threads
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to schedule multiple threads.

requirements.title: 11. Thread Options
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support a set of thread options.

requirements.title: 12. Thread Custom Data
requirements.requirement_text: Every thread shall have a custom data area.

requirements.title: 1. Timer definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and statically (i.e. compile time) initialize timers.
