requirements.title: 2. Timer expiry function
requirements.requirement_text: When initializing a timer, the Zephyr RTOS shall support setting a function that gets called when the timer expires.

requirements.title: 3. Timer stop function
requirements.requirement_text: When initializing a timer, the Zephyr RTOS shall support setting a function that gets called when a running timer is stopped.

requirements.title: 4. Timer definition at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize timers at run time.

requirements.title: 5. Timer start
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to start a timer for a specific duration and periodicity.

requirements.title: 6. Timer stop
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to stop a running timer.

requirements.title: 7. Timer status
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to read the number of times a timer has expired and then reset this count to zero.

requirements.title: 8. Timer status reinitialization
requirements.requirement_text: When a timer is initialized, started, or read via the timer status or synchronization mechanism, the Zephyr RTOS shall reset the timer's expiration count to zero.

requirements.title: 9. Timer thread synchronization
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to synchronize a thread to a timer and then block the thread's execution until any of the following conditions is satisfied: - The timer is stopped - The timer's expiration count is greater than zero

requirements.title: 10. Timer next expiration time in system ticks
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to get a timer's next expiration time in system ticks.

requirements.title: 11. Timer remaining time until expiration in system ticks
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to get a timer's remaining time until its next expiry in system ticks.

requirements.title: 12. Timer remaining time until expiration in milliseconds
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to get the timer's remaining time until its next expiry in milliseconds.

requirements.title: 13. Timer set user data
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support adding user defined data to a timer.

requirements.title: 14. Timer get user data
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support retrieving user defined data from a timer.

requirements.title: 15. Timer expire functions in interrupt context
requirements.requirement_text: When a timer expiry function is called, the Zephyr RTOS shall do so in the interrupt context.

requirements.title: 16. Timer resource cleanup
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to release the resources associated with a timer.

requirements.title: 17. Timer cleanup with pending threads
requirements.requirement_text: If a timer is cleaned up while one or more threads are still waiting on it, then the Zephyr RTOS shall leave the timer's resources unreleased and return an error indicating that the cleanup could not be performed.

requirements.title: 18. Observing timer lifecycle events
requirements.requirement_text: Where timer observers are enabled, the Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to register observers that are notified of the following timer lifecycle events: initialization, start, stop, and expiry.

requirements.title: 1. Initializing a trace
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr shall provide an interface to initialize a trace.

requirements.title: 2. Triggering a trace
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr shall provide an interface to trigger a trace.

requirements.title: 3. Dumping trace results
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr shall provide an interface to dump results from a trace.

requirements.title: 4. Removing trace data
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr shall provide an interface to remove trace data.

requirements.title: 5. Tracing Object Identification
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr shall provide an interface to identify the objects being traced.

requirements.title: 6. Tracing Non-Interference
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr shall prevent the tracing functionality from interfering with normal operations.

requirements.title: 1.1. Work queue initialization
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a work queue.

requirements.title: 1.2. Work queue start
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to start an initialized work queue, dedicating a thread to process its work items.

requirements.title: 1.3. Processing a work queue in the calling thread
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to process the work items of an initialized work queue that has not been started, in the context of the calling thread, returning only when the work queue is stopped.

requirements.title: 1.4. Work queue thread priority
requirements.requirement_text: When a work queue is started, the Zephyr RTOS shall allow the priority of its dedicated thread to be configured.

requirements.title: 1.5. Work queue thread naming
requirements.requirement_text: When a work queue is started, the Zephyr RTOS shall allow a name to be assigned to the work queue's dedicated thread.

requirements.title: 1.6. Work queue essential thread
requirements.requirement_text: When a work queue is started, the Zephyr RTOS shall allow the work queue's dedicated thread to be marked as essential to system operation.

requirements.title: 1.7. Work item processing order
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall process the work items of a work queue in the order in which they were submitted.

requirements.title: 1.8. Work queue thread yielding
requirements.requirement_text: While yielding between work items is enabled for a work queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall cause the work queue thread to yield to other ready threads between processing successive work items.

requirements.title: 1.9. Work queue thread yielding disabled
requirements.requirement_text: While yielding between work items is disabled for a work queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall not yield the work queue thread until no work items remain queued.

requirements.title: 1.10. Work queue draining
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to wait until all work items submitted to a work queue have been processed.

requirements.title: 1.11. Work item submission while draining
requirements.requirement_text: While a work queue is draining, the Zephyr RTOS shall reject submission of work items to that work queue unless the submission originates from the work queue's own thread.

requirements.title: 1.12. Work queue submission blocking on drain
requirements.requirement_text: When a drain operation is initiated with submission blocking enabled, the Zephyr RTOS shall continue to prevent submission of work items to the work queue after the drain completes, until submissions are explicitly re-enabled.

requirements.title: 1.13. Work queue submission unblocking
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to allow work items to be submitted again to a work queue whose submissions were previously blocked.

requirements.title: 1.14. Work queue stop
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to stop the dedicated thread of a work queue that has been drained and is blocking new submissions.

requirements.title: 1.15. Work queue stop timeout
requirements.requirement_text: When stopping a work queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall wait for the work queue thread to terminate for at most a caller-specified timeout.

requirements.title: 1.16. Work queue stop timeout expiry
requirements.requirement_text: If the work queue thread has not terminated when the stop timeout expires, then the Zephyr RTOS shall return an error indicating timeout and leave the work queue running.

requirements.title: 1.17. Work queue stop with an essential thread
requirements.requirement_text: If a stop is requested for a work queue whose dedicated thread is marked as essential to system operation, then the Zephyr RTOS shall reject the request and return an error indicating that the operation is not supported.

requirements.title: 2.1. Work item initialization at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a work item at run time, associating a handler function to be executed when the work item is processed.

requirements.title: 2.2. Work item definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a work item at compile time, associating a handler function to be executed when the work item is processed.

requirements.title: 2.3. System work queue
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a system work queue that is started during kernel initialization and is available to application and kernel code.

requirements.title: 2.4. Work item submission to the system work queue
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to submit a work item to the system work queue.

requirements.title: 2.5. Work item submission to a specified work queue
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to submit a work item to a specified work queue.

requirements.title: 2.6. Work item submission from threads and interrupt service routines
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall allow a work item to be submitted from either a thread or an interrupt service routine.

requirements.title: 2.7. Work item handler invocation
requirements.requirement_text: When the work queue thread removes a work item from the queue, the Zephyr RTOS shall invoke that work item's handler function in the context of the work queue thread.

requirements.title: 2.8. Resubmission of an already queued work item
requirements.requirement_text: If a work item is submitted while it is already queued and has not yet started running, then the Zephyr RTOS shall retain the work item at its current position in the queue.

requirements.title: 2.9. Resubmission of a running work item
requirements.requirement_text: If a work item is submitted while its handler function is running, then the Zephyr RTOS shall queue the work item to be processed again after the running handler function completes.

requirements.title: 2.10. Resubmission of a running work item to a different work queue
requirements.requirement_text: If a work item is submitted to a work queue while its handler function is running on a different work queue, then the Zephyr RTOS shall queue the work item on the work queue that is running it.

requirements.title: 2.11. Waiting for a work item to complete
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to wait until a submitted work item's handler function has finished executing.

requirements.title: 3.1. Work item pending status
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to determine whether a work item is currently pending, where a work item is pending while it is waiting for its delay to elapse, queued to a work queue, running, being cancelled, or being flushed.

requirements.title: 3.2. Cancellation of a queued work item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to cancel a work item that has been submitted but has not yet started running, so that its handler function is not invoked.

requirements.title: 3.3. Cancellation of a running work item handler
requirements.requirement_text: If a work item's handler function has already started running when the work item is cancelled, then the Zephyr RTOS shall not interrupt the execution of that handler function.

requirements.title: 3.4. Cancellation with wait for completion
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to cancel a work item and wait until the work item is no longer pending.

requirements.title: 4.1. Delayable work item initialization at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a delayable work item at run time, associating a handler function to be executed when the work item is processed.

requirements.title: 4.2. Delayable work item definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize a delayable work item at compile time, associating a handler function to be executed when the work item is processed.

requirements.title: 4.3. Scheduling a delayable work item on a specified work queue
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to schedule a delayable work item to be submitted to a specified work queue after a specified delay.

requirements.title: 4.4. Scheduling a delayable work item on the system work queue
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to schedule a delayable work item to be submitted to the system work queue after a specified delay.

requirements.title: 4.5. Submission of a delayable work item on delay expiry
requirements.requirement_text: When the scheduled delay of a delayable work item elapses, the Zephyr RTOS shall submit the work item to its work queue.

requirements.title: 4.6. Rescheduling a delayable work item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to reschedule a delayable work item that is scheduled but not yet submitted, replacing the previously scheduled delay with the new delay.

requirements.title: 4.7. Rescheduling a queued or running delayable work item
requirements.requirement_text: If a delayable work item is rescheduled with a non-zero delay while it is queued or running, then the Zephyr RTOS shall leave that execution unaffected and schedule an additional submission of the work item after the new delay.

requirements.title: 4.8. Cancellation of a delayable work item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to cancel a delayable work item that has been scheduled but not yet submitted to its work queue, so that it is not submitted.

requirements.title: 4.9. Waiting for a delayable work item to complete
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to wait until a delayable work item's handler function has finished executing.

requirements.title: 4.10. Waiting for a scheduled delayable work item to complete
requirements.requirement_text: When a wait for completion is requested for a delayable work item that is scheduled but not yet submitted, the Zephyr RTOS shall submit the work item to its work queue immediately before waiting.

requirements.title: 4.11. Cancellation of a delayable work item with wait for completion
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to cancel a delayable work item and wait until the work item is no longer pending.

requirements.title: 4.12. Querying the remaining delay of a delayable work item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to query the time remaining until a scheduled delayable work item is submitted to its work queue.

requirements.title: 4.13. Work item timeout monitoring
requirements.requirement_text: Where workqueue work timeout monitoring is enabled, the Zephyr RTOS shall monitor the execution duration of each work item and, if a work item handler runs longer than the configured timeout, abort the work queue thread.

requirements.title: 5.1. Triggered work item initialization
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize a triggered work item at run time, associating a handler function to be executed when the work item is processed.

requirements.title: 5.2. Submitting a triggered work item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to submit a work item that is processed when any of a specified set of poll events becomes ready or when a specified timeout elapses, and to report the triggering outcome to the work item handler.

requirements.title: 5.3. Resubmission of a waiting triggered work item
requirements.requirement_text: If a triggered work item is submitted while it is still waiting for its poll events, then the Zephyr RTOS shall cancel the existing submission and resubmit the work item with the new set of poll events.

requirements.title: 5.4. Cancelling a triggered work item
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to cancel a submitted triggered work item before any of its poll events becomes ready.

requirements.title: 6.1. User work item initialization at run time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to initialize, at run time, a work item usable by user mode threads, associating a handler function to be executed when the work item is processed.

requirements.title: 6.2. User work item definition at compile time
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to define and initialize, at compile time, a work item usable by user mode threads, associating a handler function to be executed when the work item is processed.

requirements.title: 6.3. User work queue start
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to start a work queue whose dedicated thread runs in user mode.

requirements.title: 6.4. User work item submission
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for user mode threads to submit a work item to a user mode work queue.

requirements.title: 1.1. Atomic Service
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to perform atomic operations on variables, guaranteeing that all reads and writes are free from tearing across all processors.

requirements.title: 2. Support Subset of Standard C Library
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support a subset of the standard C library.

requirements.title: 3.1. Condition Variables
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework to synchronize threads based on a condition variable.

requirements.title: 4. Device Driver Abstraction
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework for managing device drivers and peripherals.

requirements.title: 5. Fatal error and exception handling
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework for error and exception handling.

requirements.title: 6.1. Events
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to synchronize threads based on a set of events.

requirements.title: 7.1. FIFOs data passing
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall implement FIFOs which can be used to pass data between threads and interrupt service routines.

requirements.title: 8. Common File system operation support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework for managing file system access.

requirements.title: 9. Architecture Layer Interface
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework to communicate with a set of hardware architectural services.

requirements.title: 10. Support multiprocessor management
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support symmetric multiprocessing on multiple cores.

requirements.title: 11. Interrupt Management
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework for interrupt and interrupt service routine management.

requirements.title: 12. Direct ISR, Platform Specific helpers.
requirements.requirement_text: Zephyr RTOS shall support development of direct ISRs by providing platform specific code fragments and factory functions including, minimal header instructions, minimal footer instructions, low power termination, and ISR construction.

requirements.title: 13.1. Time measurement
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide services to measure the passage of time.

requirements.title: 13.2. Delaying thread execution
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide services to delay the execution of a thread for a period of time.

requirements.title: 13.3. Timeout specification
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a means to specify the timeout of a kernel operation as a relative duration or as an absolute point in time.

requirements.title: 14.1. LIFOs data passing
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall implement a LIFOs which can be used to pass data between threads and interrupt service routines.

requirements.title: 15. Logging
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework for logging events.

requirements.title: 16.1. Mailboxes
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework to pass messages of arbitrary size between threads.

requirements.title: 17. Memory Management framework
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support a memory management framework.

requirements.title: 18.1. Message Queues
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for threads and interrupt service routines to asynchronously exchange fixed-size data items.

requirements.title: 19.1. Multiple CPU scheduling
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support scheduling of threads on multiple hardware CPUs.

requirements.title: 19.2. Scheduling
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to assign a thread to a specific CPU.

requirements.title: 20. Power Management
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface to control hardware power states.

requirements.title: 21.1. Pipes
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism to transfer a stream of bytes between threads.

requirements.title: 22.1. Polling
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a mechanism for a thread to wait concurrently for any one of multiple conditions to be satisfied.

requirements.title: 23.1. Queues data passing
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall implement a queue which can be used to pass data between threads and interrupt service routines.

requirements.title: 24.1. Stacks
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall implement a stack which can be used to pass data between threads and interrupt service routines.

requirements.title: 25.1. Mutex
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide an interface for managing communication between threads.

requirements.title: 25.2. Counting Semaphore
requirements.requirement_text: The system shall implement a semaphore synchronization primitive for coordinating access to shared resources among multiple threads.

requirements.title: 26.1. Thread support
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall support threads.

requirements.title: 26.2. Thread management
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework for managing multiple threads of execution.

requirements.title: 26.3. Thread priority
requirements.requirement_text: Threads shall have a priority.

requirements.title: 27. Timers
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework for managing time-based events.

requirements.title: 28. Tracing
requirements.requirement_text: Zepyhr shall provide a framework mechanism for tracing low level system operations (NOTE: system calls, interrupts, kernel calls, thread, synchronization, etc.).

requirements.title: 29.1. Work Queues
requirements.requirement_text: The Zephyr RTOS shall provide a framework to offload the processing of work items to a dedicated thread.
